direct_claims: This chart compares countries' sex ratio at birth with their sex ratio at age five in 2023.
The measure is males per 100 females for both birth and age five.
The source is the UN World Population Prospects (2024), presented by Our World in Data.
The chart includes a reference line for equal ratios between birth and age five, and countries above that line have a higher sex ratio at birth than at age five.
Countries near the equality line have similar male-to-female ratios at birth and at age five.
The chart is cross-sectional for 2023 rather than a time series, so it compares countries at one point in time instead of showing change over years.
The image provides country-level examples but not the full underlying numeric table in the supplied metadata.
